action.name: Open Terminal Here
action.description: Open the default terminal in this folder

action.name: Open in Cursor
action.description: Open this folder or file in Cursor

action.name: Open with Zed
action.description: Open this folder or file in Zed

action.name: Edit in Neovim
action.description: Edit the file in Neovim in a floating terminal

action.name: Copy Path
action.command: sh -c 'printf "%%s" "$1" | wl-copy && notify-send -a Thunar -i edit-copy "Path copied" "$1"' _ %f
action.description: Copy the full path to the clipboard

action.name: Set as Wallpaper
action.description: Use this image as the wallpaper (desktop, lock screen, login)

action.name: To PNG
action.command: sh -c 'for f; do magick "$f" "${f%%.*}.png"; done; notify-send -a Thunar -i image-x-generic "Converted to PNG" "$# file(s)"' _ %F
action.description: Save a PNG copy next to each image

action.name: To JPG
action.command: sh -c 'for f; do magick "$f" -quality 92 "${f%%.*}.jpg"; done; notify-send -a Thunar -i image-x-generic "Converted to JPG" "$# file(s)"' _ %F
action.description: Save a JPG copy (quality 92) next to each image

action.name: To WebP
action.command: sh -c 'for f; do magick "$f" -quality 90 "${f%%.*}.webp"; done; notify-send -a Thunar -i image-x-generic "Converted to WebP" "$# file(s)"' _ %F
action.description: Save a WebP copy (quality 90) next to each image

action.name: Copy SHA-256
action.command: sh -c 'h=$(sha256sum "$1" | cut -d" " -f1) && printf "%%s" "$h" | wl-copy && notify-send -a Thunar -i security-high "SHA-256 copied" "$h"' _ %f
action.description: Copy the file's SHA-256 checksum to the clipboard

action.name: Open in Ark
action.description: Edit the archive in Ark: add or delete files, set a password, test it

action.name: Compress to ZIP
action.description: Pack the selection into a .zip next to it, named after it

action.name: Compress to 7z
action.description: Pack the selection into a .7z next to it (smaller than zip)

action.name: Run with Proton
action.description: Run a Windows program with Proton (Faugus prefix)

action.name: Run with Proton (NVIDIA)
action.description: Run a Windows game with Proton on the NVIDIA GPU
